fusions.name: Rust Through
fusions.desc: Your weapon runs with rusting water for one strike that deals 30 damage, ignores the target's armour, leaves it [Corroding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Corroding Spray
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Sprays a cone of rust-laden water 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Quenched Bulwark
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of quenched iron that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Ballast
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you carry 10% water resistance.
